structured_decoding: llama.cpp JSON schema from existing prompts, uniformly for all systems
structural_schema_specialization: Observation source first; empty context forbids context source; context quotes restricted to full context or exact sentences; judgment IDs/counts bound to requested IDs. Does not verify visual truth. Claim IDs/texts assigned deterministically in input unit order; dependencies limited to earlier claims; contradiction IDs limited to other known claims; evidence references must have observation-ID syntax. Core DAG/existence checks retained. Ordered-DAG constraint can miss forward-premise links.
algorithm_changes: EIGR selection/intervention algorithms unchanged; task-derived structural decoding/model differ from hosted study
collection_order: system-major, shared raw drafts then EIGR then four controls then abstention
review_warning: Self-judged AI estimates; generator and judge share weights. Not independent validation.
development_adaptation_disclosure: Claim identity/link constraints added after observing graph failures on these original development cases. Dependencies restricted to earlier draft units after a separate demo produced a cycle. This ordered-DAG representation cannot encode forward-premise dependencies. Not held-out validation or evidence of generalization.
